info.name: ETP Assessment Extension - NEW endpoints
info.description:
ONLY the endpoints added in the latest change. Five new routes — every other existing route is unchanged and is NOT included here.

All requests use the gateway `access_token` header (the standard `api_auth_gateway` token). Set the collection variables `base_url`, `access_token`, `assessment_id`, `assignment_id`, `category_id` once and hit Send.

request.description: NEW. Paginated table of every `etp.assessment.evaluator` row with `is_violated = True`. Supports filters `assessment_id`, `employee_id`, `violation_reason`, `date_from`, `date_to`.

NEW. Dashboard-friendly cards. Returns:
  - `kpi` block (Total / Affected candidates / Affected assessments / one card per reason)
  - `chart` block (doughnut, by reason)
  - `table` block (10 most recent)

Same filters as the list endpoint.

NEW. One-shot deep view of an assessment, like Odoo's `etp.assessment/35`. Returns:
  - `assessment`  - the same payload as `GET /assessments/<id>`
  - `stats`       - candidate / response / violator totals + completion rate
  - `candidates`  - one row per assignment (state, progress, score, violation info)
  - `questions`   - one row per question served by this assessment

NEW. Per-candidate deep view. `assignment_id` is the `etp.assessment.evaluator` PK (the row from the candidate list). Returns:
  - `candidate`   - header (state, progress, score, violation)
  - `assessment`  - brief header
  - `responses`   - one entry per question (question name, type, score, state, per-dimension selected option, justification)
  - `summary`     - aggregate totals

NEW. Deep view for a category. Used when the user clicks a question's category from inside the assessment detail screen. Returns:
  - `category`        - header (name, sequence, question_count, ...)
  - `questions`       - every active question in this category
  - `type_breakdown`  - count + percent per question_type
  - `assessments`     - every assessment whose `category_id` is this one
